projects.title: Telecom Customer Churn Prediction Engine
projects.subtitle: Big Data streaming & ML pipeline built with XGBoost, SMOTE, Apache Spark & Kafka
projects.problem: Telecommunication providers face high customer attrition with heavily imbalanced dataset distribution, making early churn detection difficult.
projects.solution: Engineered an end-to-end churn prediction pipeline using XGBoost with SMOTE resampling, real-time Kafka data ingestion, and Spark ETL processing to power retention dashboards.
projects.businessImpact: Significantly boosted predictive recall on at-risk customer segments and enabled real-time churn risk scoring for proactive customer retention.
projects.architectureNotes: Utilized Apache Kafka for real-time customer event streaming into Apache Spark structured streaming buffers before scoring with optimized XGBoost classifier models.

projects.title: Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) System
projects.subtitle: Audio signal deep learning classifier extracting MFCCs & spectrogram features
projects.problem: Raw speech audio signals contain high-dimensional acoustic variations, making emotion classification non-trivial for AI systems.
projects.solution: Built an automated audio preprocessing & classification pipeline utilizing librosa for MFCC and spectrogram feature extraction paired with TensorFlow and Scikit-Learn classifiers.
projects.businessImpact: Achieved high classification accuracy across emotional states (Happy, Sad, Angry, Neutral) suitable for automated call-center sentiment analysis.
projects.architectureNotes: Extracted 40 MFCC coefficients, zero-crossing rates, and chroma features using librosa, fed into neural networks and ensemble classifiers.

projects.title: Tomato: Web-Based Food Delivery Platform
projects.subtitle: Full-stack food ordering microservices with Stripe payments & live order tracking
projects.problem: Local restaurants required an end-to-end web platform for customer ordering, restaurant menu management, and real-time delivery status telemetry.
projects.solution: Developed a full-stack web application enabling real-time order placement, restaurant admin tools, live status tracking, and integrated Stripe payment gateway.
projects.businessImpact: Streamlined restaurant menu updates and order fulfillment while ensuring secure, instant online transaction processing.
projects.architectureNotes: Designed normalized relational MySQL database schemas for menu items, customer accounts, and real-time order state updates.

projects.title: Audio Attribute Music Recommendation Engine
projects.subtitle: Personalized song recommendation engine leveraging audio feature analysis
projects.problem: Users struggle to discover new songs matching their acoustic preferences without effective content-based filtering engines.
projects.solution: Engineered a content-filtering recommendation algorithm analyzing audio feature attributes and user feedback vectors to deliver personalized track recommendations.
projects.businessImpact: Enhanced recommendation relevance and discovery by incorporating real-time user feedback scoring into filtering loops.
projects.architectureNotes: Computed cosine similarity matrices across normalized track acoustic vectors (danceability, energy, valence) for sub-50ms song retrieval.
